questions.question: What is a crop? Name four things crops need to grow well.
questions.expected_answer: A crop is a plant that farmers grow for food or to sell. Crops need good soil, water, the right temperature and sunlight.

questions.question: Name three important crops in South Africa and say what each one is used for.
questions.expected_answer: Maize is used for maize meal and animal feed. Wheat is used for bread and flour. Sugar cane is used for sugar. Sunflowers are used for cooking oil. Fruit such as oranges, apples and grapes is eaten fresh or made into juice.

questions.question: Describe what happens on an apple farm in Ceres in winter, spring and at picking time.
questions.expected_answer: In winter, the trees lose their leaves, rest in the cold and are pruned. In spring, they blossom and bees pollinate the flowers. From about January to May, the fruit is picked by hand, taken to the packhouse, washed, sorted, packed and kept in cold stores.
